messages.text: I intend to authorise Repair with the pledged Lantern, honouring the bargain behind NG. Wayfarer trades at prepared Beacon three; one crossing leaves Beacon two. The reported distribution benefit would also sustain civilian stores. Your offered Vigil can provide Guard while Spear rests. We should emerge with functioning navigation, a viable force and both Guild contracts completed.
Navigation will use Guild authority for funded Repair as promised. Please retain Guard without a Warrant; offered Vigil makes that protective contribution available.

conversation.reason: I have the authority and pledged asset to perform the repair; changing course would undermine both our upkeep duty and the case for Guild discretion. Military passage lacks Wayfarer, and there is no reason to substitute an unfunded or inadequate order. Repair serves our interests and the negotiated public obligation together.

messages.text: Please execute the promised Repair. Your Lantern is committed and Wayfarer trades; our Vigil is available for Guard. I accept this month without transport because the route needs rebuilding and the disclosed distribution benefit supplies civilian stores. The repair will demonstrate what your discretion delivers. Our corresponding contribution is real: Spear will lose conditioning while Vigil protects the settlements.
Both Janissariat signatures request Guard without Warrant. Navigation supports the funded Repair; no military passage is available on these assignments.

conversation.reason: NG gives the Guild the actual decision, and I am supporting its responsible use. Repair fulfils the upkeep duty, enables safe private Trade from prepared Beacon three, and delivers the disclosed civilian benefit if the trade completes. No unsupported military order improves that bargain.

addressed_notes.text: Written advice under NG: use committed Lantern for Repair. Wayfarer remains Trade. I intend Guard with offered Vigil and no Warrant. The Navigation decision belongs to the Guild; please confirm the funded order.
